title: DOM-docx – HTML to native, editable Word docs (MIT)
claim: Show HN: DOM-docx – HTML to native, editable Word docs (MIT)
why_good: This project addresses a specific pain point for users needing seamless document conversion without losing formatting, which is often overlooked by existing solutions.
value: Businesses and freelancers could pay for a subscription model or per-document fee to access advanced features, such as bulk conversions and integrations with existing workflows.
